posts.title: Kagi News
posts.description: Kagi News offers a different approach to keeping up with current events. It brings together stories from thousands of community-curated news sources around the world and uses AI to create a concise daily briefing. posts.title: SocialSpec
posts.description: SocialSpec is developing open standards that let independent websites connect and interact as part of a decentralized social network. Using simple HTTP requests and existing feeds, websites can offer social profiles, following, and contact information without HTML scraping or centralized platforms. Micro.blog now supports the Follow API, with optional plugin support for the About and Contact APIs.
